# DevFn

> Trusted local profiles, process and Compose lifecycle, port leases, readiness, and localhost routes.

## Documentation

- [Configuration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/configuration.md) — Declare project identity, ports, processes, Compose services, and profiles.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Initialize, trust, inspect, and start a local profile.
- [DevFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Trusted lifecycle orchestration for local development.
- [Lifecycle and diagnostics](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/lifecycle.md) — Start, inspect, stop, and recover one worktree instance.
- [Migrating a project](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/migration.md) — Adopt DevFn while preserving existing startup and data paths.
- [Packages](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/packages.md) — Map DevFn's eight packages to their responsibilities.
- [Ports and localhost routes](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/ports-and-proxy.md) — Allocate per-worktree ports and publish concrete local URLs.
- [Processes and Compose](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/processes-and-compose.md) — Run native applications and worktree-scoped infrastructure.
- [@devfn/cli](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/cli.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/cli.
- [@devfn/compose](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/compose.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/compose.
- [@devfn/config](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/config.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/config.
- [Configuration contract](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/configuration.md) — Manifest fields, ports, processes, services, profiles, and policy.
- [@devfn/core](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/core.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/core.
- [Reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — DevFn configuration, security, migration, and package guides.
- [Migration guide](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/migration.md) — Adopt DevFn without losing existing scripts, outputs, or Compose data.
- [@devfn/ports](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/ports.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/ports.
- [@devfn/processes](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/processes.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/processes.
- [@devfn/proxy](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/proxy.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/proxy.
- [Security contract](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/security.md) — Manifest trust, secret handling, local exposure, and ownership.
- [@devfn/testing](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/reference/testing.md) — Source package guide for @devfn/testing.
- [Trust and secret handling](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/devfn/docs/content/docs/security.md) — Review manifests, isolate secrets, and confirm public exposure.
